evidence_note: This pack is the DELINEATION layer, not the calculation kernel: given the pillars, hidden stems, Ten Gods, seasonal command, and branch relations the live engine (src/engine/multitradition/bazi.py) already computes, these rules state what a classical named configuration MEANS, quoted directly from the inspected Chinese and rendered by the engine's own unreviewed translation (rendering_grade: engine_translation_unreviewed throughout, per DEFENSIBILITY.md's 'translation is not a gate for quotation'). All 22 rules are drawn from the ctext.org transcription of Yuanhai Ziping (chapter=901791) - specifically its Wanjin Fu (萬金賦), Four-Character Verses (四言獨步), Five-Character Verses (五言獨步), Five-Phase Generation-Control Rhapsody (五行生克賦), and Luozi's Tidings Rhapsody (珞琭子消息賦) sections - none of which were catalogued in the prior Wikisource-only inspection recorded in bazi/source_audit.md. ctext's own edition record for this title states its version as 暫缺 (no controlling print source identified), so evidence_grade stays C, matching the existing engine disclosure's grade for this same underlying work; this pack does not claim an edition-control upgrade for Yuanhai Ziping itself (see bazi_yuanhai_ziping_gugong_zhenben_facsimile_lead in the registry for that unresolved lead). Every rule carries customer_prediction: false. Rules whose classical text states a lifespan, death, violent-punishment, or gendered/moralizing claim are marked output_policy: refused and are retained ONLY as historical quotation, per the tradition's own refusal list in bazi/defensibility_spec.md; the structural (non-refused) remainder of each such rule is what a future composer may use. No rule here selects a named pattern (格局), a useful/avoidant element (用神), or a strength-class verdict as settled - those axes remain source_gated exactly as recorded in bazi/defensibility_spec.md, and nothing in this pack narrows that gate.

When the Eating God has qi, it surpasses Wealth and Officer - one need only fear it being damaged or cut off from without. The relative weight of these must be distinguished in fine detail; it is a great taboo for Wealth or Officer to fall into a dead or cut-off state.

scope.chapter: 四言獨步 / 珞琭子消息賦 (Four-Character Verses / Luozi's Tidings Rhapsody)

conditions.phase_qi_direction: advancing (coming into season) or retreating (departing season)

conclusion.judgment: advancing qi is not yet dead; retreating qi is not yet reborn - dormant is not the same as extinct
conclusion.chinese: 進氣退氣，命物相爭；進氣不死，退氣不生。 [supporting: 其為氣也，將來者進，成功者退；如蛇在灰，如鱔在塵。]
conclusion.engine_rendering: Advancing qi and retreating qi contend with the chart's substance; advancing qi does not yet die, retreating qi does not yet regenerate. As for this qi: what is coming is advancing, what has finished its work is retreating - like a snake in ash, like an eel in dust.
conclusion.note: A direct qualitative nuance on the engine's already-implemented wang/xiang/xiu/qiu/si seasonal-state computation: a phase transitioning out of season ('退氣') is dormant, not equivalent in force to a phase in the fully opposed ('死') state.

conclusion.judgment: generation/prosperity in the Seal luck period brings glory and flourishing, and meeting an Officer township there brings promotion; a death/cutoff state there is calamity; Wealth arriving to damage the Seal is unfavorable, but the Seal undamaged by Wealth is not fatal
conclusion.chinese: 第一限逢印綬鄉，運生生旺必榮昌。官鄉會合遷官職，死絕當頭是禍殃。若是逢財來害印，墮崖落水惡中亡；為官在任他鄉死，作客逢之死路傍。印不逢財人不死，如前逐一細推詳。
conclusion.engine_rendering: If the first luck period enters the Seal-Resource township, and its state is generation or prosperity, the native is surely glorious and flourishing. If the Officer township is met and combines, office and rank are promoted; if death/cutoff confronts it directly, calamity follows. If Wealth instead arrives to harm the Seal [the classical rhetoric names cliff-falls, drowning, dying away from home in office, or death by the roadside as a traveler]. If the Seal is not met by Wealth, the person does not die - each case must be reasoned through individually as above.
conclusion.output_policy: The specific death-mode imagery (falling from a cliff, drowning, dying away from home, roadside death) is refused as customer output per the refusal list; the structural doctrine - first Seal-luck period favorable in generation/prosperity, unfavorable if Wealth damages the Seal - may be retained without that imagery.

conclusion.judgment: two occurrences of one branch do not clash a single occurrence of its clash partner - the same proportional-count principle applies to Wealth, Officer, and Seal-Resource groupings; a luck period that overcomes/breaks this balance is severe
conclusion.chinese: 二子不衝午；二寅不衝申；得一分三格，財官印綬同；運中逢克破，一命喪黃泉。
conclusion.engine_rendering: Two Zi do not clash a single Wu; two Yin do not clash a single Shen. Obtaining one part in three, Wealth, Officer, and Seal-Resource are alike; when the luck period meets an overcoming and breaking of this, life is lost.
conclusion.output_policy: The closing death clause ('一命喪黃泉') is refused as customer output per the refusal list; the structural clash-multiplicity doctrine is retained.
conclusion.note: This directly QUALIFIES the engine's already-implemented branch_relations().six_clashes field (checklist item 7), which currently reports a clash purely by presence of both members without weighing relative branch counts. This rule does not change engine output; it is a delineation nuance for a future composer to apply on top of the existing structural fact.

exceptions: The verse does not state what threshold of imbalance is needed beyond the 2-versus-1 example given for Zi/Wu and Yin/Shen; whether the same ratio generalizes to all six clash pairs is not addressed by this passage alone.
